sun.swing

类 PrintingStatus

  • java.lang.Object
    • sun.swing.PrintingStatus

  • public class PrintingStatus
extends Object
    The PrintingStatus provides a dialog that displays progress of the printing job and provides a way to abort it

    Methods of these class are thread safe, although most Swing methods are not. Please see Concurrency in Swing for more information.

    从以下版本开始:
    1.6
    作者:
    Alexander Potochkin

      • showModal
